Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK : SAFAIWALA & CHOWKIDAR The following staff has been authorized vide PDDE, EC, Kolkata letter No 360120/DEO/ITANAGAR/ESTT/LC-1/02 dt 0 2 Sept 2019, to be outsourced from reputed firms through GeM for this office located at Model Village, Naharlagun, Aruna chal Pradesh. The details are as under :- S. No Category Scope of work Qualification & Experience

(i) Safaiwala To ensure cleanliness of office, dusting of computer 8 th Class Pass; Should be able s, tables, etc. to read and write Hindi and En glish (ii) Chowkidar To keep vigil on unwarranted activities during office 10 th Class Pass; Should be abl and night hours. To maintain visitor register. Openi e to read and write Hindi and ng and closing of office and safe custody of office lo English ck and keys. To ensure safety of office inventories fr om theft and to prevent its usage by unauthorized personnel. 2. Statutory Documents / Certificates listed below are required to be uploaded else Bidder’s offer is liable to be reject ed during technical evaluation if they do not upload any of the certificates / documents listed below :- a) License to engage in the business of Private security agency under Private Security Agency (Regulation) Act 2005 and relevant Rules, issued from time to time/Labour license issued by the Competent authorit y of Govt. of India as applicable. b) Establishment Registration Certificate c) Allotment letter issued by Commissioner of ESIC and EPF regarding Establishmen tCode number. d) GST Registration Certificate e) Proof of Experience during the last three years, v iz GeM/Non Gem Contracts/Work Completion. (Self ce rtificate will not be considered) f) PAN card g) Bank Mandate Form & cancelled cheque (for initial billing). 3. All terms and condition governed by SLA (Service Level Agreement) under GeM contract is applicable alongwith th e following ATC (Additional Terms & Condition) as under (a) The service provider is required to pay salaries/wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e, on th eir own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents /supporting as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. In case of prolonged delay in processing the vendor’s bill, the service provider has t o continue paying the wages upto 03 months. (b) The service provider has to ensure that enhanced VDA (Variable Dearness Allowance) is admitted in the daily wages from time to time as and when notified by Govt of India, Ministry of Employment, Chief Lab our Commissioner, New Delhi (c) DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh reserves the right to cancel the contract at any time with one month’s notice in case of non satisfactory service/administrative ground or breach of contract. (d) The Firm/Agency shall be responsible for the orderly and discipline behavior of his workmen towards all stakehold ers including office employees. The contractor shall be bound to withdraw immediately any workman responsible for mis conduct and if found not performing up to the expectations of this office.

(e) The Firm/Agency shall ensure that any dispute between him and his workmen is settled outside the office premise s, and they shall in no way utilize the premises property etc., for this purpose. (f) The Contractor shall not substitute any of their workmen engaged by him with another/any of their workman, with out prior approval of this office. (g) The Contractor shall be fully responsible for timely compliance of all statutory requirements in respect of his empl oyees. The Defence Estates Office, Itanagar Circle, Naharlagun, Arunachal Pradesh shall not be responsible for the paym ent of any amount to his employees/statutory authorities on account of non-compliance of statutory provisions applicable to them. Daily Attendance Register of his employees supplied will be maintained by this office. (h) Working hours :- Safaiwala : 0900 hrs. to 1730 hrs from Monday to Friday Chowkidars : 08 hrs duty (06 days a week). However, working hours and days are subject to change as per the amount of work to be carried out i.e, Saturda y and Sunday may also be working days which will be incorporated in attendance sheet. (i) No fooding and lodging will be provided. 4. Payment : Monthly Invoice/Bill on the basis of attendance for the resources to be prepared and forwarded to thi s office alongwith with its supporting documents. After receipt of service provider’s bill by this office, the same will be pr ocessed with AAO Jorhat either online or offline as the case may be. The final payment will be released/credited in the ac count No of the firm directly by AAO Jorhat. This office will not be responsible for any delayed payment and no interest will be paid for such delays. 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Past Project Experience

Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a.
